new_value: Per draft-lichen-link-01.md section 3.2 the SI bit IS LLSec bit 7 (0x80): 'Bit 7 (SI): Signer IID present', and section 4.1 places SIID(8) in signed_data when SI=1 - so the existing mask was spec-correct but undocumented and untested dead-looking code (mainline spec/02-physical-link.md section 4.2 + reserved_bit7_reject vector still reserve bit 7 at parse time). Fixed via option (b): added pub const LLSEC_SI_BIT with spec citations, used it in build_signable, expanded sign_frame/verify_frame docs on IID coverage conditional on the bit. New tests: SI set covers signer_iid (wrong IID fails), SI clear ignores signer_iid (deterministic signatures identical, any IID verifies), and SI-frame serialize+verify roundtrip documenting that LichenFrame serialization does not yet carry the SI bit.
